model.start: original frozen base plus fresh LoRA; never continue a smoke adapter
model.quantization: NF4 double quant, BF16 compute, SDPA

data.padding: right, to current microbatch length; batch1 has no padding
data.schedule: shuffle within each bucket; form full groups; pool bucket leftovers; shuffle all full groups; append the final incomplete group

training.normalization: sum of micro_mean_loss * micro_valid_targets / actual_group_valid_targets; no extra division by 8
training.clip_policy: once after every microbatch in the group has completed backward, then one optimizer step

scheduler.indexing: j is the 1-based optimizer update about to execute; set lr before optimizer.step
scheduler.formula: peak*j/24 for j<=24; peak*(796-j+1)/(796-24+1) for 24<j<=796; zero after completion
scheduler.state: completed_updates, next_group_index, next_update_lr, immutable schedule hash; never restart warmup on resume

checkpoint.boundary: after successful complete-group optimizer step and next-lr advancement, then zero_grad; never midway through accumulation
contents: optimizer state including moments and steps
Python NumPy Torch CPU and CUDA RNG states
model data prompt tokenizer config package and source hashes
checkpoint.write_policy: write to a new temporary checkpoint directory, read back and hash-check, then atomically rename and mark complete; preserve previous complete checkpoint
checkpoint.resume_order: verify hashes; rebuild identical base and LoRA; restore adapter, optimizer and LR state/cursor; restore RNG last; continue saved schedule without reshuffling
checkpoint.interruption_policy: stop on failure; incomplete/possibly partial group is not a committed checkpoint; explicit resume uses last complete checkpoint, recording replayed work

validation.baseline: reuse existing baseline reports; do not regenerate the base
validation.when: once after epoch-end adapter at update 796; interim checkpoints are for recovery, not model selection
validation.protocol: same prompt/tokenizer/model version/NF4; batch1 greedy, one result per question, max_new_tokens256; frozen EX protocol
validation.final_set: sealed; not read, trained on, tuned on or evaluated in this step

resources.estimate_limit: scenario estimate, not measured formal throughput or guaranteed memory ceiling; both context and target length matter
resources.calibration_before_full_run: bounded real-trainer pilot across all length buckets with accumulation, checkpoint and resume; not authorized or executed in this CPU step
stops: training window exceeded: finish current group if healthy, save a resumable checkpoint and stop; no silent extra epoch or retries
